title: Group and Sum with reduce
prompt:
Given `orders` (an array of `{ user, total }` objects, already declared in the boilerplate), write `sumByUser(orders)` that RETURNS an object mapping each user to the sum of their totals.

Use `reduce` — no `for` loops.

tests.name: returns correct grouped totals
tests.hint: reduce with an empty object as the initial accumulator; add each total to acc[o.user].

tests.name: handles an empty list
tests.hint: With no items, reduce returns the initial value — that is why the initial accumulator matters.

tests.name: uses reduce, not for loops
tests.code: if (/for\s*\(/.test(code)) throw new Error("Use reduce for this one — no for loops.");
tests.hint: orders.reduce((acc, o) => { … return acc; }, {}) is the whole solution.
